question.text: What is the significance of September 28, 2015 for commodity markets in India?

answer.text: FCRA 1952 was repealed and regulation of commodity derivatives shifted to SEBI under SCRA 1956; commodity and securities derivatives markets were later integrated operationally
The date when MCX was established
The date when India joined WTO
The date when FCRA was first enacted

explanation.text: The Logic: With effect from September 28, 2015, FCRA 1952 was repealed and regulation of commodity derivatives moved to SEBI under SCRA 1956. Operational integration of commodity derivatives with securities derivatives markets followed. The Trap: MCX was established earlier; India joined the WTO in 1995; FCRA was enacted in 1952. Note: The pages checked do not name FMC as the explicit transferor or describe a single-regulator unification across equity, currency, and commodity derivatives, so that wording is intentionally avoided.
